[P1] Reject failed NESTED containers during FLAT replay

When a recorded terminal branch has a FAILED NESTED container and the configuration changes to FLAT, identity validation succeeds and the subsequent `checkpoint.is_failed()` shortcut returns the cached error without calling `_execute_item_in_child_context`, where container presence is rejected. Replay therefore accepts the nesting drift. In FLAT mode, reject every existent branch-container checkpoint before success/failure handling (including the fallback reconstruction path), and add failed-branch map/parallel ReplayChildren tests.
